title: Hopf-like bifurcations induced by hysteresis and time-delay near monodromic tangential singularities
summary: We investigate planar piecewise-analytic vector fields, focusing on the merged focus and other monodromic tangential singularities when hysteresis or time-delay is incorporated into the switching condition. If the singularity is an asymptotically stable solution of the system with an instantaneous switch, then the introduction of hysteresis or time-delay causes an attracting limit cycle to be formed locally.
